parsed_entries.requirement: A Data Fiduciary must obtain consent from the Data Principal before processing personal data.
parsed_entries.source: DPDP Act 2023, Section 3(OBLIGATIONS OF DATA FIDUCIARY)(a)
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document explicitly states that consent must be obtained from the Data Principal before processing personal data.
